body.statement: The projection of \(\mathcal G_H(p_{BT},q)\) onto \((B,W)\) equals \(\Gamma_H(p,q)\). Every \(x\in\Gamma_H(p,q)\) extends to \(\gamma\in\mathcal G_H(p_{BT},q)\) by \(\gamma_{btw}=p_{bt}x_{bw}/p_b\) when \(p_b>0\), with arbitrary zero-row values when \(p_b=0\).
body.justification: The lemma shows that conditioning the switched residual on the observed intensive residual creates no hidden loss of sharpness.
body.gap: Classical two-margin transport results do not verify compatibility with the identified \((B,T)\) joint law required by the recurrent-event estimand.
body.consumer: The endpoint and policy calculations can optimize over the smaller Ferrers polytope without discarding information about continued intensive treatment.
